title: Recovery
entry_footer: Whole-install bundles are separate from program backups for hub updates.
entry_hint: Inspect existing bundles, check their integrity, and find safe recovery guidance.
overview_hint: Persona never creates a consistent whole-install bundle while the hub is running. Checks happen only when you ask.
boundary_footer: This page does not restore an installation, download bundles, or export private keys. Restore remains a terminal operation.
protect_footer: Includes the hub and built-in assistant only. Independently hosted assistants are not included. Program backups for hub updates are separate.
empty: No bundles found in the standard Recovery folder. A bundle stored elsewhere is not shown.
old_hub: This hub does not offer Recovery reads yet. Use the terminal guidance below; no bundle has been checked here.
bundle_missing: That bundle is no longer listed. Refresh before checking another one.
not_drill: Both dumps restored into temporary databases. This is not a restore drill and no services were started.
create_title: Create a bundle in a terminal
create_stop: 1. On the hub machine, stop the hub and built-in assistant with your installation's service commands. This page will disconnect.
create_run: 2. After both have stopped, run this command. The --writes-quiesced flag confirms that writes are stopped; Persona still refuses active database writers.
create_restart: 3. Restart the hub and built-in assistant, then return here to inspect the new bundle.
create_footer: Keep the bundle private: it contains private keys. Store a copy somewhere other than the hub machine.
verify_command_hint: If Web verification is unsupported, run this command where the required PostgreSQL tools and database are available:
history_unavailable: No authoritative restore or drill history is available to show.
drill_boundary: This page does not perform a restore or start services. A passing integrity or database check is not a service-starting restore drill.
reason_compose: The shipped Docker Compose deployment is not supported for creation or database verification here. Run the terminal workflow where PostgreSQL tools are installed, or use the documented dump steps.
reason_postgresql_tools: PostgreSQL client tools of the server's major version are unavailable. Install them or use the documented container workflow.
reason_configuration: This installation's hub or built-in assistant database configuration is unavailable for verification. Offline inspection is still available.
reason_external_manager: An independently hosted assistant is outside this whole-install bundle's scope.
reason_unsafe_directory: The standard Recovery folder is not a private, owner-only directory. No files were listed or read.
reason_unreadable_directory: The standard Recovery folder could not be read. No bundle status is inferred.
reason_limited: Showing the 50 newest regular files in the standard Recovery folder.
reason_invalid_bundle: This file is not a readable, intact Persona bundle. Use the terminal inspect command for a redacted diagnostic.
reason_bundle_changed: The bundle changed during the check. Refresh and check the new revision before trusting a result.
reason_verification_failed: The dumps did not pass temporary-database verification. Use the terminal verify command for a redacted diagnostic.
reason_unknown: The status is unavailable or unverified; no successful check is assumed.
